noise_summary_scope: Known finite nonnegative estimates from all selected ROIs, including inactive ROIs; calcium uses the actual GetSn estimate from new analysis or the selected extraction; CASCADE uses stored per-ROI model noise. Never substitute one scale for the other.
advisory_warning_scope: Completed batch only; at least four known FOV medians; Q1/Q3 +/- 3 linear IQR; skip zero IQR and unknown model identity; CASCADE groups match resolved model, weights manifest and model sampling rate. Does not alter thresholds/results or assert biological accuracy.
